expected_symptom: dxc fails internally in HLMatrixLower's HLMatrixSubscriptUseReplacer while lowering Param.Matrix[2].r.xxx on a local float3x3 -- scored by internal_failure (abnormal termination or a build-agnostic internal-error marker), never by the reported message text.
history: fixed in v1.8.2502 (repro'd v1.4.1907..v1.8.2407, 14 releases; clean v1.8.2502..v1.9.2607, 6 releases; no invalid probes; defect predates the oldest release carrying a dxc asset)
summary: Does not reproduce on main (1.9.0.5433, 13730886e): the AnyHit repro compiles clean at -T lib_6_3, the oldest profile that can express [shader(anyhit)]. Reproduced on all 14 stable releases from v1.4.1907 through v1.8.2407 and clean from v1.8.2502 on, with no invalid probes, so the defect predates the oldest release carrying a dxc asset. Scored with internal_failure, which is load-bearing: the same defect exits 0xC0000005 with completely empty stderr (v1.4.1907, v1.5.2010), 0xE0000002 'Internal compiler error: LLVM Unreachable' (v1.6.2104), 0x80AA001C with the reporter's message (v1.6.2106, v1.6.2112), and E_FAIL with 'error: Unexpected matrix subscript use.' (v1.7.2207..v1.8.2407, classified only by the UNREACHABLE marker since E_FAIL is excluded from INTERNAL_STATUS); manual-case-predicate-counterfactual.txt measures three naive predicates each reporting a different wrong history. Cause: HLMatrixSubscriptUseReplacer::replaceUses handles only loads and stores, and pre-fix codegen left .r an lvalue so it emitted 'bitcast float* to <1 x float>*' on the subscript pointer; v1.8.2502 loads the <3 x float> and extractelements instead, so the fix is in Sema/codegen, not the lowering pass. Strong but unbisected attribution to 0372fb792 (PR #6930), which adds CK_LValueToRValue in LookupVectorMemberExprForHLSL for duplicate-element swizzles: present in v1.8.2502, absent from v1.8.2407, and on v1.8.2407 .r.x compiles while .r.xx crashes; the tag window is 133 commits, 4 touching SemaHLSL.cpp, and nothing was built at that commit. The fix emits correct code rather than silence -- the repro and the reporter's .xxx workaround produce byte-identical DXIL on v1.8.2502 and on main. The reporter's quoted output matches v1.6.2106 and v1.6.2112 exactly, line 91 included. Not raytracing-specific: the identical subscript in cs_6_0 fails the same way on v1.4.1907, v1.6.2106 and v1.8.2407. Controls (workaround, feature-presence anyhit, compute stage, duplicate and no-duplicate swizzle) were run on 4-5 representative builds, not all 20.
title: AnyHit Shader hits `llvm_unreachable("Unexpected matrix subscript use.")`
